Housing creation in Portland, Oregon · 2000 to 2026

Project list

Every project counted on this site, from City of Portland building permit records through November 10, 2026. Search by address, neighborhood or permit number, narrow the list with the filters, and select a column heading to sort.

One row is one project: building permits filed within 40 meters and 270 days of each other are grouped. New homes are the homes the project adds; net new is new homes minus homes demolished on the same site. LU approved is the year the city approved the project's land use review. Approval Time is the number of years, to the nearest tenth, from the day the city first received that land use application to the day the first building permit was issued. Both are shown for projects that went through a design or historic review that could be matched to the project; they are blank for projects that needed no such review, and for land divisions. Funding is tagged for projects of five or more homes: subsidized means state, local bond or federal tax-credit money, or university housing, and a market-rate project with required inclusionary units counts as market rate. The permit number is the first permit in the project and can be looked up on PortlandMaps. Expired or cancelled projects are listed but are not counted in the site's totals of permitted homes.
